target.title: fix(gateway): reject altered approval history cursors
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where operators paging terminal approval history could submit altered spellings of a server-issued cursor, including appended junk, padding, or extra JSON fields, and have them accepted as the same keyset position.

## Why This Change Was Made

The history decoder now requires both an exact base64url byte round-trip and an exact round-trip through the existing cursor encoder. Approval decisions, retention, database queries, and the SQLite schema are unchanged. The main risk is rejecting a cursor emitted by OpenClaw itself; the existing two-page pagination test and the canonical negative control cover that boundary.

## User Impact

Operator approval history now rejects altered or non-emitted continuation cursors with the existing invalid-cursor error while valid cursors continue paging normally.

## Evidence

On `upstream/main` at `ba62b944fa4`, I ran the same external harness against the real exported `listTerminalOperatorApprovals()` function, backed by a real temporary OpenClaw SQLite state database on Node v24.18.0:

```text
{"node":"v24.18.0","firstPage":["proof-new"]}
canonical: accepted -> proof-old
appendedJunk: accepted -> proof-old
padded: accepted -> proof-old
extraField: accepted -> proof-old
```

On this branch, with the same harness and inputs:

```text
{"node":"v24.18.0","firstPage":["proof-new"]}
canonical: accepted -> proof-old
appendedJunk: rejected -> OperatorApprovalHistoryCursorError: invalid operator approval history cursor
padded: rejected -> OperatorApprovalHistoryCursorError: invalid operator approval history cursor
extraField: rejected -> OperatorApprovalHistoryCursorError: invalid operator approval history cursor
```

Focused validation:

```text
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/operator-approval-store.test.ts
Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests  26 passed (26)

./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check src/gateway/operator-approval-store.ts src/gateway/operator-approval-store.test.ts
All matched files use the correct format.

./node_modules/.bin/oxlint src/gateway/operator-approval-store.ts src/gateway/operator-approval-store.test.ts
exit 0

.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode uncommitted
autoreview clean: no accepted/actionable findings reported
overall: patch is correct (0.97)
```

`check-changed` could not run locally because this linked worktree's pnpm dependency check requested a non-interactive `node_modules` reinstall; full checks are left to fork CI.

AI-assisted: Codex helped implement and review the change; the production-function before/after proof and focused validation above were run manually.
